Mayawati's Nephew Akash Anand Changes Social Media Bio Amidst Party Speculation

Bahujan Samaj Party (BSP) leader Akash Anand, nephew of party chief Mayawati, has changed his social media bio on X (formerly Twitter) from 'BSP worker' to 'supporter'. This change follows Mayawati's recent statement calling him "immature" for politics and removing him from the post of Chief National Coordinator. Speculation is rife that he may have been expelled from the party again, with reports suggesting Mayawati might announce his removal. The shift in his role and potential party action has led to discussions about political realignments, with questions raised about who might benefit from the situation, including opposition leaders Akhilesh Yadav and Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath.
